exposure: Immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (IPPIUCD) insertions
outcome: Safety (perforation, irregular bleeding, unusual vaginal discharge, and infection)
cohort: 593 women who underwent vaginal or caesarean deliveries with IPPIUCD insertions over a two-year period at a tertiary care teaching institute
finding: IPPIUCD insertion was associated with low complication rates overall, but spontaneous expulsions and undescended strings were more common after vaginal insertions.
mod_finding: Spontaneous expulsions of IPPIUCDs were significantly higher in vaginal insertions (p = 0.042), and the incidence of undescended strings was significantly higher in vaginal insertions (p = 0.000).
